sources.title: qwen-mt-plus Model Info
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the exact Plus page identifies a Qwen3-derived flagship translation model, 92 languages, terminology control, text input/output, function calling unsupported, and a 16,384-token context with 8,192 input and output limits. It supplies no nominal total or active parameter count, size-specific Qwen3 base model, or dense-versus-MoE structure.

sources.title: Machine translation (Qwen-MT)
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27; page dated October 11, 2026. Describes Qwen-MT as fine-tuned from Qwen3 and explicitly lists Plus as a 92-language offering. The named lineage is the Qwen3 family, without a size-specific base or any nominal total/active count for Plus. Documents hosted API usage, terminology intervention, domain prompts and translation memory; no Plus checkpoint or weight license is identified.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the July 22, 2025 Beijing and July 24 international/global entries describe a Qwen3 upgrade for qwen-mt-plus. They identify no size-specific base, total count or active count. These are regional upgrade/availability dates, not proof of the initial historical release of the unversioned alias.

sources.title: Text generation model capabilities
sources.evidence: The exact qwen-mt-plus row marks thinking mode, function calling, built-in tools and structured output unsupported.

sources.title: Qwen-MT: Where Speed Meets Smart Translation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the July 24, 2025 announcement explicitly introduces qwen-mt-turbo. Its lightweight MoE statement therefore does not establish Plus topology or counts. Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-235B-A22B appear as benchmark comparators, not named base models for Plus.

sources.title: Models.dev qwen-mt-plus record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog source was followed; its claims were checked against developer documentation rather than treated as primary technical evidence.

sources.title: qwen-mt-plus model information (Chinese)
sources.evidence: Checked October 27: the Chinese exact-model page likewise describes Plus as upgraded from Qwen3, without naming a size-specific checkpoint. Its numerical tables describe context limits, prices and rate limits, not model parameter counts. No nominal total/active count or dense-versus-MoE designation is published here.

name.note: Display-name normalization of official Qwen-MT-Plus; exact API identifier is qwen-mt-plus.

developer.note: Official Alibaba Cloud documentation presents this as its Qwen translation model.

family.note: Explicitly part of the Qwen series; current translation model derives from Qwen3.

release_date.note: July 22 Beijing and July 24 international/global entries explicitly describe a Qwen3 upgrade; neither establishes initial availability of the unversioned Plus alias.

open_weights.note: Reviewed primary sources document hosted API access but do not explicitly establish closed weights or provide a downloadable Plus checkpoint. API access alone does not prove weight availability; baseline false is not independently verified.

license.note: No model-weight license is disclosed in the reviewed exact-model documentation. Do not transfer a license from open Qwen3 checkpoints.

parameters_b.note: Fresh review found no developer-published nominal total for Plus. Qwen3 fine-tuning is explicit, but no size-specific base is identified, so nominal size cannot be inherited. The launch post concerns Turbo; its named Qwen3 sizes are benchmark comparators.

active_parameters_b.note: No developer-published active count or size-specific base supports inheritance for Plus. The Turbo-only MoE description does not establish Plus routing or active size; neither a sibling count nor equality with an unknown total is justified.

architecture.note: Qwen3 derivation is established, but the exact Plus dense/MoE topology is not disclosed. The blog identifies Turbo, so its architectural claims cannot establish Plus architecture.

context_window.note: Explicit context window in tokens; maximum input and output are each 8,192.

modalities.note: Exact-model capability table lists text for both input and output.

reasoning.note: The exact-model capability table explicitly marks thinking mode unsupported.

description.value: Flagship Qwen translation model with terminology control and support for 92 languages
description.note: All factual elements match the exact-model documentation; flagship is the developer designation.

sources.label: Alibaba model lifecycle and regional dates

patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts are undisclosed. Qwen3 lineage is documented without a size-specific base; Plus dense/MoE architecture and weight availability remain unestablished. July 22 (Beijing) and July 24 (international/global), 2025 describe the Qwen3 upgrade; initial alias release remains unverified.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reopened English/Chinese Plus documentation, the updated translation guide, lifecycle entries and the Qwen-MT launch post, then searched for nominal counts and named-base lineage. Neither total nor active count is supported: Qwen3 names a family, and the launch post covers Turbo with Qwen3 sizes used only as comparators. Explicit null parameter patches retained; all other field assessments preserved.
